messages:
violet: Quick callout 1: need lock on launch checks for private deploy onramp. Proposals: relay-first installer, optional static egress VIP, BGP as paid add-on, rolling patch upgrades with safety window. Can we agree?

raj: Relay-first makes sense to reduce customer networking dependency. Static egress VIP is useful for customers with ACLs; provide a template to request/claim a VIP.

meera: For upgrades, rolling patches default. Add a safety window metric: measure 95th percentile time-to-recover and require <30m for core services during canary. Add automatic rollback if >2 smoke failures in 5m.

jamie: Installer UX: show a simple mode chooser: Relay / NAT (static VIP) / BGP (advanced). Default to Relay with a tooltip "recommended for first install". Also add a "preflight run" that emits JSON to stdout for automation.

violet: Telemetry policy: default OFF for private. If customers enable, require explicit scope selection and an audit token. CLI: `redwoodctl telemetry grant --scopes=errors,metrics` prints token.

oncall-bot: Created ticket PD-9012 "onramp launch checks + installer modes" and assigned to @violet @raj @meera @jamie.

raj: Field ask: include a short maintenance blurb for docs: "Rolling patches typically complete within 15-45 minutes; network cutovers (VIP/BGP) may need scheduled downtime up to 2 hours."

meera: I'll add automated tests for preflight and the rollback criteria into CI.

violet: OK locking these choices. Action owners: Jamie -> installer mode chooser & UI copy, Raj -> VIP template & comms, Meera -> preflight + rollback CI tests, Violet -> RFC. Target RFC Wed morning.

jamie: ack

meera: ack :thumbsup:
thread_text_summary: Short decision thread: agree relay-first installer, optional static egress VIP, BGP as add-on, rolling upgrades with rollback criteria, telemetry default off; action owners and ticket created
